Package io.telekom.orchest.telemetry

Class OrchestTelemetryService

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.OrchestTelemetryService
@Component public class OrchestTelemetryService extends Object
Service for reporting telemetry data and metrics. Uses Micrometer to publish metrics to configured backends (e.g., Prometheus). Defines common metric names and helper methods for incrementing counters.
